title: Row coefficient
statement: For a natural number $\ell$ and a rational learning parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq 1/2$, the row coefficient is $2^\ell(\ell+B(\delta)+1)$, where $B(\delta)$ is the number of bits assigned to the Fourier estimator's failure probability.
caveat: The definition of the Fourier estimator failure-bit count is not included in the payload.
